I have farmed rice on this lowland plot since I was young, and I know that the soil here gives us a decent harvest if we work hard with our own hands. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer or those new seeds from town, and we have no need for irrigation because the rains and the wetland keep the rice growing. My family will manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves over the season.
